main_text.head: D. OPT. MAX. S. ET MEMORIÆ CL. V. D. IOHANNIS STURMII, SUMMAM PIETATIS, ERUDITIONIS, FACUNDIÆ LAUDEM ADEPTI, SUMMIS REGIBUS ET PRINCIPIBUS GRATI, DE CIVITATE ET ACADEMIA ARGENTINENSI OPTIME MERITI.
main_text.p: Si[?] laudem Pietas ullam syncera meretur / Veris sui cultoribus: / Eximia si qua est Doctrinae gloria: doctae / Est si qua laus facundiae:
Si summis imisque piis placuisse, malorum / Hostem fuisse perpetem,
Est vitae locuples testis vindéxq; probata, / Ipsis crepantibus invidis:
Ecquis te, STVRMI, vixit felicior? ecquis / Te mortuo beatior?
Non igitur, STVRMI, te lugeo: lugeo nullos / Superesse mundo Sturmios.
THEODORUS BEZA AMICISS. / SUO M. P.

page.notes: Decorative fleuron band above the heading, not transcribed. Small capitals in "D. Opt. Max. S." and "Cl. V. D." are set in capitals here. Spelling changed only for u/v and i/j as the rules require. The woodcut initial is decorative and hard to read; the first letter is given as "Si" with [?]. Lines are run together within each stanza, since the poem's line breaks are not kept. The long s is written as plain s. Faint show-through from the reverse side, including "D. OPT.", is omitted.
